promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes

best_for.detail: $0 brokerage commission for HK stocks via ZA Invest; platform fee applies (no per-trade commission)
best_for.why_others_lose: PAObank charges brokerage commission for HK stock trades despite zero platform fee — $0 commission (ZA) beats any commission charge; Airstar also charges trading commission.

best_for.detail: $0 brokerage commission for US stocks via ZA Invest; platform fee applies
best_for.why_others_lose: PAObank charges USD 0.012/share commission for US trades — not zero. ZA Bank's $0 commission is structurally superior for retail investors.

best_for.detail: Free crypto trading platform fee for new customers for 90 days
best_for.why_others_lose: Only bank currently offering this promotion.

best_for.detail: Up to 2% Unlimited CashBack with qualifying balance or payroll
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers 1% stock cashback (StockBack) while Mox offers up to 2% cashback, providing double the return.

best_for.detail: New customers receive HKD 2,026 in rewards package
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox Bank's welcome offer provides up to HKD 1,500, which is HKD 526 less than ZA Bank's package of HKD 2,026.

best_for.detail: Travel promotion with up to 28,500 miles
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank and WeLab Bank offer travel insurance and card benefits but don't provide airline miles rewards as substantial as Mox's 28,500 miles (enough for round-trip Asia flight).

best_for.detail: Instant loan rate as low as 1.18% with cash reward up to HKD 10,888
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab Bank offers personal loan cash rebate up to HKD 23,888 but doesn't specify a rate as low as Mox's 1.18%; Ant Bank offers SME loan cash rebate but doesn't specify a competitive APR.

best_for.detail: WeLab Global Wallet Best Exchange Rates Guarantee for international transfers
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab offers a 'best rates guarantee' which explicitly promises better FX rates than competitors; other banks offer multi-currency capabilities but don't guarantee they provide the best rates.

best_for.detail: 0% subscription fees on ALL funds with no cap until July 31, 2026
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox's 0% fund subscription fee promotion ends earlier (June 30); WeLab's promotion is limited to select funds; PAObank waives fees only for money market funds while ZA covers all funds.

best_for.detail: Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open ZA Bank accounts
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab Bank offers HKD 800 per personal loan or Tesla loan referral with a lower potential total compared to ZA Bank's program that allows earning up to HKD 90,000.

ZA Bank.focus: comprehensive investment platform, high-value welcome offers
strengths: $0 commission stock trading
0% fund subscription fee on all funds
HKD 2,026 new customer reward package
Up to HKD 90,000 referral program
Free crypto trading platform fee for 90 days
ZA Bank.expiring_alert: Fund position rebate vouchers, HK stock cash rebate, and 20% p.a. time deposit offers expire on May 27, 2026

Mox Bank.focus: cashback, travel rewards, competitive loan rates
strengths: Up to 2% Unlimited CashBack
Travel promotion with up to 28,500 miles
Instant loan with rates as low as 1.18%
0% fund subscription fee
Diverse merchant-specific promotions
Mox Bank.expiring_alert: Several promotions ending on April 30, 2026, including tax payment rewards, instant loan promotion, and Indulge and Grow bonus deposit offer
Mox Bank.vs_za_pros: Higher cashback rate (2% vs 1% StockBack), lower published loan APR, more travel-specific rewards including airline miles
Mox Bank.vs_za_cons: Lower welcome bonus (HKD 1,500 vs ZA's HKD 2,026), smaller referral program maximum, shorter fund subscription fee waiver period

WeLab Bank.focus: FX rates, global wallet, loan referrals
strengths: Best FX rates guarantee
$0 foreign currency transaction fee
Personal loan cash rebate up to HKD 23,888
HKD 800 per loan referral
WeLab Bank.expiring_alert: Personal loan cash rebate and referral campaigns expire on June 30, 2026
WeLab Bank.vs_za_pros: Explicit guarantee for best FX rates, zero foreign currency transaction fees on debit card
WeLab Bank.vs_za_cons: No commission-free stock trading, lower referral program ceiling, limited fund promotion compared to ZA's all-funds approach

Free HKD30 Pacific Coffee voucher
Zero commission on HK stock trades for eligible accounts
24/7 instant bank transfers in multiple currencies
Airstar Bank.expiring_alert: Pacific Coffee voucher and zero handling fee for first mainland China remittance are limited-time offers
Airstar Bank.vs_za_pros: Zero commission on HK stocks advertised as 'forever' for eligible accounts
Airstar Bank.vs_za_cons: Fewer promotional offers overall, no explicit crypto offering, no large welcome bonus package comparable to ZA's HKD 2,026

strengths: Libra Savings with up to 2.0% p.a. interest rate
Up to HKD 100,000 cash rebate on SME loans
Zero fees for fund subscriptions and redemptions
Early withdrawal from time deposits without penalty
Ant Bank.expiring_alert: SME loan cash rebate and fund platform transaction fee waiver are limited-time offers
Ant Bank.vs_za_pros: Higher published savings rate (2.0% p.a.), larger SME loan cash rebate (up to HKD 100,000), time deposit early withdrawal without penalty
Ant Bank.vs_za_cons: No commission-free stock trading platform, no substantial retail investor welcome bonus comparable to ZA's package

strengths: Flash Monday HKD Time Deposit promotion
Enhanced interest rates on savings
Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rewards
Global remittance services
Fusion Bank.expiring_alert: All three active promotions (Flash Monday deposits, Savings Interest Plus, and FX Time Deposit) are limited-time offers
Fusion Bank.vs_za_pros: Special Monday-only time deposit rates, specific foreign exchange time deposit incentives
Fusion Bank.vs_za_cons: Fewest active promotions among all virtual banks, no investment platform offerings comparable to ZA's commission-free stock trading

PAObank.focus: investment tools, market data, low thresholds
strengths: Free HK stock real-time Level 1 market data
Low minimum investment threshold (USD 20 for US money market funds)
Professional stock analysis tools with 40+ technical indicators
Zero platform fee for HK and US stocks
PAObank.vs_za_pros: Zero platform fee for stocks (while ZA charges platform fee), more extensive technical analysis tools, lower minimum investment thresholds
PAObank.vs_za_cons: Charges brokerage commission for stock trades (USD 0.012/share for US stocks) while ZA offers $0 commission, no active promotional campaigns

Tax deduction for Wang Fuk Court Support Fund donations
Comprehensive insurance offerings (travel, home, pet)

livi bank.expiring_alert: liviSave Preferential Interest Rate, livi Rewards Universe, and tax deduction for donations are time-limited offers
livi bank.vs_za_pros: More diverse insurance product portfolio, unique QR code cash withdrawal system, tax deduction benefits
livi bank.vs_za_cons: No investment platform comparable to ZA's commission-free stock trading, fewer active promotions overall
